name: Security vs Smugglers
desc:
🛃 WELCOME TO SECURITY VS SMUGGLERS! ✈️

👮 Security: Scan luggage, search passengers, and inspect items to find hidden contraband. Catch smugglers to earn Cash and win.

🕵️ Smuggler: Smuggle items, hide them in your luggage, blend in with the crowd, and trick Security to escape with rewards.

🔥 Features:
🦸 Unlock powerful abilities
💼 Discover unique contraband items
💵 Earn Cash
👥 Play with friends in every round

⚠️ Every round changes—Security must catch all smugglers before they escape, or smugglers win big!

👍 LIKE ⭐ FAVORITE for updates!
⚠️-this game is very new, if you find bugs contact us through the link.
